commit_message: R2.8.145: repair Canvas ID readback gates
status: Exact-SHA CI terminal but not passing on 89da1495fac160fc77029ea4ad60c9c47724148b: 7/7 workflows and 20/20 jobs terminal; 6/7 workflows and 19/20 jobs passed, with the sole failure in Linux vault round-trip. All 16 artifact records, all 3 round-trip report payloads, and the platform evidence reports are reconciled.

failure_findings.failure: Linux exact Canvas text-card ID visual readback failed; target crop included the widget's right border, so OCR returned text-1 | despite matching fresh field-state bytes/hash. No paste/save was attempted.
failure_findings.root_cause: OCR false negative from the crop including the target widget's right border; screenshot shows text-1 and the trailing vertical bar is the border.
failure_findings.proposed_bounded_repair: For Linux paired-geometry Canvas ID capture only, inset the crop's right edge by two screenshot pixels; retain the generic exact matcher and all state/freshness/geometry/sibling guards.

artifact_reconciliation_note: All 16 API artifact records are tied to the submitted head SHA and their names/IDs/sizes/digests/expiry dates are recorded. Three round-trip archives and nine small platform evidence archives were downloaded and their SHA-256 values match GitHub API digests. Four preview bundles are accounted for by exact-SHA API metadata; their payloads were not downloaded.
